model_chain.scope: RET 0x14 establishes five stack argument slots including self, not their full semantic contract.

resource_open_boundary.scope: Internal worker appends this suffix to its selected name prefix and dispatches to the next loader stage. Resource search directories, archive precedence and the complete filename-selection behavior are not reconstructed.

ghidra_metadata_repair.callsite_override: The +0x78 reset call cleans one four-byte stack argument. Correcting this prevents the subsequent resource-name argument from shifting into the model slot.

model_file_header.subsequent_dispatch: First-table records begin with four-byte flags. Bit 0x04000000 selects driver slot +0x5c and reader 1002be30; otherwise slot +0x58 and reader 1002bbe0. This does not yet establish a complete table format or authoritative material-type names.
model_file_header.scope: Only the prefix checks are reconstructed. Header acceptance does not validate the table, model geometry, parent links, file completeness or successful runtime loading. Short reads are explicitly rejected by our source; the original calls do not consistently check returned read lengths.
